_contract.purpose: Explicit allowlist for the T00 mandatory no-skip gate (policy A, owner-approved 2026-09-12).
semantics: A real pytest.skip()/pytest.importorskip() call inside a mandatory T* test file is accepted ONLY when (a) the file source is OS-conditional ('platform.system' present — unchanged rule), or (b) ALL of the following hold: the file is listed in 'entries'; the call's statically-extractable reason text contains at least one of the entry's 'reason_patterns'; and the file source still contains the entry's 'env_guard_token'.

Everything else still FAILS (fail-closed): undeclared files, undeclared reasons, missing env guards, stale entries (allowlisted file with no real skip call), missing/malformed/marginally-valid contracts.
pytestmark whole-file skips and decorator skips (skip/xfail/skipif) are NEVER allowlisted here.
The gate prints a 'declared_infra_skips:' summary for every green run so declared skips are never silent.
_contract.review_rule: Adding, changing or removing an entry is a deliberate, reviewed contract change: edit this file AND update the pin test test_declared_infra_skip_allowlist_pins_known_files in tests/T00_integrity/test_meta_audit.py. No wildcards: each entry names exactly one file and only the reason patterns actually present in that file.

entries.guard_description: Session fixture chromium_ready skips only when the playwright package import fails or a real headless chromium launch via sync_playwright() fails.
entries.justification: Playwright + chromium browser is an external browser dependency that may be absent on CI/local runners; the PlaywrightBackend itself is opt-in and every non-browser behavior of the suite still runs as hard assertions.

entries.guard_description: Container evidence tests are opt-in via a pytest.mark.skipif on SCP_EE_CONTAINER_TESTS=1; inside those tests pytest.skip fires only when the docker CLI is unavailable or the scp-egress-ee image is not built.
entries.justification: EE-G1 container runtime evidence needs a REAL docker daemon and a locally built scp-egress-ee image (expensive, opt-in); without them there is no container to prove the deny-mode egress contract against, and the in-process egress tests still run as hard assertions.

entries.guard_description: pg_dsn fixture skips when SCP_PG_TEST_DSN is unset; INFRA-SKIP when the real PostgreSQL refuses the connection.
entries.justification: Boot-on-Pg runtime parity needs a REAL PostgreSQL server (no mocks); without SCP_PG_TEST_DSN there is no database to prove anything against, and the in-memory kernel path is covered by the rest of T04.

entries.guard_description: evb fixture skips when SCP_PG_TEST_DSN is unset; INFRA-SKIP when the real PostgreSQL refuses the connection.
entries.justification: PgEventBus suite needs a REAL PostgreSQL server for LISTEN/NOTIFY semantics (no mocks); absent DSN means no database to prove anything against.

entries.guard_description: pg_admin_dsn fixture skips when SCP_PG_TEST_DSN is unset (docker hint in the reason).
entries.justification: SQLite->Postgres migration proof needs a REAL PostgreSQL server; absent DSN means no target database to migrate into.

entries.guard_description: _base_dsn/pg_dsn fixtures skip when SCP_PG_TEST_DSN is unset; INFRA-SKIP when the real PostgreSQL refuses the connection.
entries.justification: Chaos scenarios deliberately kill/restart a REAL PostgreSQL server (no mocks); absent DSN means no server to chaos-test.

entries.guard_description: pg_storage fixture skips when SCP_PG_TEST_DSN is unset; INFRA-SKIP when the real PostgreSQL refuses the connection.
entries.justification: Storage parity proof compares the REAL Postgres backend against the kernel store (no mocks); absent DSN means no Postgres side of the parity pair.

entries.guard_description: Event-bus eval roundtrip skips when SCP_PG_TEST_DSN is unset, when psycopg is not installed, or when the real PostgreSQL refuses the connection (INFRA-SKIP).
entries.justification: C3 Sandbox Evaluator E2E event roundtrip needs a REAL PostgreSQL via psycopg (no mocks); the remaining evaluator E2E assertions still run unconditionally.
